jobs.title: Intern, Corporate Development Analyst
jobs.description:
At Ball, integrity and trust are the foundation of who we are. Guided by our core values —"We Care. We Work. We Win.”— we create a culture where every voice matters and every idea drives progress.

Together with our global employees, customers, and partners, we’re turning bold sustainability goals into reality and shaping a future we can all be proud of.

Create a new future. Apply Today.

Position Overview:

Our internship program is designed for students enrolled in an accredited university or college who are interested in developing on-the-job skills, experiences and insights that last a lifetime. Over the course of 10 weeks, you will have opportunities to learn about several areas of our business, network and collaborate with Ball leaders, and get involved in challenging project work.

The Corporate Development Analyst Intern will gain knowledge across corporate finance and the mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and investment lifecycle while working on various projects/deals throughout the summer.

What You’ll Do:

- Support project work in corporate development, in partnership with Ball’s business divisions and functions.

- Research and analyze markets and target companies to support potential Mergers & Acquisition (M&A) activities.

- Collect, process, and analyze financial data from various sources that are utilized by the corporate development team.

- Stay up-to-date on the latest economic, financial, and industry trends and learn how these changes impact Ball.

- Assist Corporate Development team with financial analysis on potential strategic acquisition and investment targets.

- Help create presentations for senior management.

- Meet with key financial counterparts to learn about current activities with the M&A markets.

- Attend professional development activities, including a professional development week at our corporate headquarters in Colorado.

What We Are Seeking:

- Current students pursuing a bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Analytics, or other related disciplines at an accredited 4-year college or university.

- And has completed at least one year of coursework with a graduation date of December 2027 or later.

- Applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship now or in the future.

- Demonstrated interest in corporate finance and the mergers and acquisitions space.

- Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills.

- Attention to detail and accuracy.

- Proficiency in analyzing financial information and building financial models.

- Proficiency Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to work collaboratively and with minimal direction in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Gain:

- Hands-on experience in mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and venture investments in  a corporate business environment.

- Mentorship and guidance from experienced leaders.

- Exposure to corporate finance and cross-functional issues.

- Professional networking opportunities.

- A potential pathway for full-time consideration post-graduation.

Compensation & Benefits:

- Hourly Rate:  $24 - $26 (hourly rate is dependent on education level)

- May be eligible for additional housing benefits

- Hybrid On-Site Work Environment: Based in Colorado, this position requires regular in-person engagement by working on-site for three (3) or more work days per work week (with core collaboration days of Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday). Travel and local commute between Ball locations and other possible non-Ball locations may be required..

When submitting your application to Ball, we encourage you to emphasize your skills, experience, and qualifications that align with the role.

Ball Corporation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody. All qualified job applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, aboriginality, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, veteran status, age, political affiliation or any other non-merit characteristic.

jobs.title: Manager, Plant HRBP - Frutal/MG
jobs.description:
​

At Ball, integrity and trust are the foundation of who we are. Guided by our core values—"We Care. We Work. We Win.”—we create a culture where every voice matters and every idea drives progress.

Together with our global employees, customers, and partners, we’re turning bold sustainability goals into reality and shaping a future we can all be proud of.

Create a new future. Apply Today.

*This position will be posted internally for a minimum of 5 days and will remain open until filled or adjusted based on the volume of applicants.

**Please, note that this is a 100% onsite position in our Frutal/MG plant. Make sure you evaluate and understand about the location before applying.

Primary purpose of this position: Act as the strategic HR partner at the site level, ensuring alignment between business objectives and people management by overseeing labor compliance, workforce planning, employee development, engagement, and cultural transformation while supporting leaders and organizational performance.

Main Responsibilities:

- Manage the headcount budgeting process (salaries, benefits, labor agreements, merit increases, and other HR-related expenses) by defining budgeting methodologies, monitoring budget execution, implementing defined assumptions, and identifying gaps between budgeted vs. actual figures, ensuring compliance with the company’s financial planning for the current and upcoming year.

- Participate in union negotiations, representing the company in meetings and collective bargaining agreements in compliance with legal requirements and company strategy.

- Monitor labor inspections (Labor Department, Social Security, Ministry of Labor, Public Prosecutor’s Office) and other audits conducted within the company, providing required documentation in compliance with current legislation.
Coordinate and ensure planned internal communication and endomarketing activities, promoting engagement and motivation through actions that mobilize all involved professionals.

- Identify training needs and plan/execute development initiatives aimed at employee growth, both behavioral and technical, while monitoring the effectiveness of training plans and actions.

- Support the implementation of Engagement Survey action plans related to the assigned area by participating in analyses and proposing initiatives to support execution.

- Provide employee support by answering questions and offering career development guidance (coaching, counseling, and direction), aligned with company policies.

- Support managers and directors in people management through guidance, best practices, and feedback.

- Support the Compliance area through investigations, report creation, interviews, and provision of relevant information.

- Monitor and manage strategic HR indicators by analyzing monthly reports and developing action plans to achieve performance targets.

- Manage HR processes at the site level through close collaboration with the Production Manager and regional HR teams.

- Actively participate in the site’s strategic planning, ensuring alignment between business goals and people management practices.

- Lead cultural transformation initiatives, supporting leaders in promoting company values, behaviors, and practices aligned with corporate strategy.

- Monitor internal and external audits related to Human Resources practices, ensuring compliance with corporate policies, labor laws, and regulatory requirements.

Requirements:

- Completed Bachelor’s degree preferably in Business Administration, Accounting, Engineering, Law, Economics, or Human Resources Management.

- Knowledge of Labor and Social Security legislation.

- Experience with Personnel Administration routines, Experience as an HR Generalist.

- Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office.

- Experience with ERP systems, preferably SAP/Datasul and SuccessFactors.

- Advanced level of English.

jobs.title: Sr. Security Analyst - GRC (São José dos Campos/SP)
jobs.description:
At Ball, integrity and trust are the foundation of who we are. Guided by our core values—"We Care. We Work. We Win.”—we create a culture where every voice matters and every idea drives progress.
Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!
Create a new future. Apply Today.
* This position will be posted internally for a minimum of 5 days and will remain open until filled or adjusted based on the volume of applicants.

Your Opportunity to Make an Impact
At Ball, every role contributes to something bigger. Learn how this opportunity will allow you to grow your career while making a lasting impact on our business, our communities, and our planet:

As a Senior Analyst within Cybersecurity Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) , you will play a critical role in strengthening Ball Corporation’s global cybersecurity program. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will help ensure cybersecurity risks are effectively managed, compliance obligations are supported, and governance processes enable informed business decisions. This role offers the opportunity to lead key GRC workstreams while influencing the security posture of a global organization.

How You'll Make a Difference
The responsibilities below represent more than daily tasks. They are opportunities to make a difference, collaborate with talented colleagues, and contribute to meaningful outcomes:

- Lead cybersecurity governance activities, including policy and standards reviews, control mapping, and maintenance of governance frameworks.

- Support enterprise cybersecurity risk management through risk identification, assessment, prioritization, treatment tracking, and reporting.

- Coordinate cybersecurity compliance, audit, and assurance activities, including evidence collection, findings management, and remediation validation.

- Conduct higher-risk third-party and supplier security assessments, providing recommendations for risk mitigation and decision-making.

- Develop and maintain cybersecurity metrics, dashboards, executive reporting, and governance documentation to support organizational oversight.

- Partner with cybersecurity, IT, legal, procurement, finance, and audit stakeholders to drive consistent and effective GRC processes globally.

What Helps You Thrive in This Role
We're looking for curious minds, collaborative spirits, and motivated professionals ready to make an impact. Here are the skills and experiences that will help you succeed in this role:

- Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

- Experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, compliance, audit, or related disciplines.

- Working knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001, CIS Controls, and related regulatory requirements.

- Strong analytical, documentation, and risk assessment skills with attention to detail and evidence quality.

- Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across global teams.

- Professional certifications in cybersecurity, risk, or compliance are preferred, along with proficiency in English.

Additional Information

- Location: São José dos Campos/SP - Brazil

- Hybrid On-Site Work Environment: This position requires regular in-person engagement by working on-site for three (3) days per work week (with core collaboration days of Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday).

- Schedule: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM

Ball Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, faith, ability, or orientation. Our products range from infinitely recyclable aluminium cans, cups to aerosol bottles solutions that enable our customers to contribute to a better world.
Each of us has a deep commitment to diversity and inclusion which is the foundation of our culture of belonging. Everyone at Ball is making a difference by doing what we love. Because what we create may change, but what we will always make is a difference.

At Ball, every role contributes to something bigger. Learn how this opportunity will allow you to grow your career while making a lasting impact on our business, our communities, and our planet:

As a Sr. IT Operations Analyst , you will play a key role in implementing and supporting complex technology solutions that enable business performance and service excellence across Ball. You will work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external partners to translate operational requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring service stability, operational resilience, and business continuity. The role includes supporting and coordinating critical operational processes such as major incident management, service monitoring, problem management, outage resolution, and continuous service improvement initiatives.

The responsibilities below represent more than daily tasks. They are opportunities to make a difference, collaborate with talented colleagues, and contribute to meaningful outcomes:

- Drive continuous improvement through industry best practices, automation initiatives, and support for user acceptance testing.

What Helps You Thrive in This Role

We're looking for curious minds, collaborative spirits, and motivated professionals ready to make an impact. Here are the skills and experiences that will help you succeed in this role:

- Experience in IT Operations, NOC, Service Management, Infrastructure Support, or Major Incident Management.

- Proven experience managing high-impact production incidents within global, enterprise-scale environments.

- Strong analytical problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and project coordination abilities.

- Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred and a relevant professional experience.

- Deep familiarity with cloud/on-premise environments (servers, networks, databases), monitoring tools, and ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management).

- Experience implementing and supporting complex business systems and technology solutions.

- Knowledge of business analysis, requirements gathering, system design, testing methodologies, and software development lifecycle processes.

- Familiarity with ITIL, COBIT, Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or other process improvement frameworks.
